notes: Ikebukuro stair and escalator dressing, parameterised from scene/dressing_anchors.json by stations/ikebukuro/pipeline/build_kit_catalog.py (do not edit by hand). Origins and yaw per anchor are in kit_placements.json. Contains PLATEAU data (MLIT), CC BY 4.0, modified.
